why: Readers fetch genes/v3/<SYMBOL>.json, catalog/v3/index.json, the style picker's picker/v1/styles.json and GeneGuessr's leaderboard/v1/top.json straight from the CDN with fetch(), so Bunny must add Access-Control-Allow-Origin for .json (Bunny applies CORS per file extension). Those objects are rewritten in place, and Bunny replicates an overwritten storage file to other regions asynchronously: measured 2026-10-02, edges re-pulled a stale replica more than two minutes after a write and purge, then kept it for the pull zone's 30-day cache time. The edge rule gives the mutable objects a 60 s edge cache time, so staleness is bounded by replication lag plus 60 s; immutable portraits and blots keep the zone default. Applied by POST /api/iconoplasm/admin/publication/reconcile-pull-zone with the Worker's own Bunny account key; scripts/reconcile-iconoplasm-pull-zone.mjs sends this file from the deploy.

edgeRules.description: Mutable stable objects: 60 s edge cache
